Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the recruiting manager as Sir Matt Busby by uncritically accepting a misleading search snippet and not verifying timelines. Busby was not Manchester United’s manager in the late 1980s; Sir Alex Ferguson recruited David Beckham, and his correct managerial timeframe is 1986–2013. This premature assumption led the Planner to pursue and finalize the wrong manager and timeframe.
